processed_topology_cache.reuse_if: producer terminal, exact source hashes, DeepCenter epoch/hash, source-reference node counts within a predeclared 0.5% bound, and CSV hash all verify
processed_topology_cache.fallback: rerun the exact in-kernel public comparator materializer with the same 0.5% source-reference drift bound

adaptation.feature_extraction: independent for each backbone with model-specific hard negatives
adaptation.sampling_policy: scan all 195 movies for candidate recall, then apply a deterministic balanced per-movie cap before concatenation

variant_grid.linker_grid: includes conservative 0.80 postprocess-division preservation and a correction-only high-base-support arm
variant_grid.zero_policy: an exact zero means outside candidate support; preserve the available model instead of treating missing support as negative evidence

validation.topology: hash-bound audited public final-CSV postprocessor output with stable raw edge confidence transfer and a maximum 0.5% node-count drift from the prior validator artifact
validation.selection_objective: maximize the minimum per-movie proxy delta versus base across the two embryo prefixes, then pooled score and worst movie
validation.acceptance_rule: positive proxy delta and worst-movie regression no worse than 0.01

launch_condition: Run directly after the active sequential gate: this lane strictly subsumes the unlaunched general-only probe and avoids duplicating its feature-extraction GPU cost.
promotion_rule: candidate must beat the frozen processed-topology comparator on disjoint acceptance movies
submission_policy: training and clean acceptance only; no submission code
